parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description:
Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit; a retry reuses it) that makes a retried request safe.
Required on every POST; answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required` when absent and 400
`idempotency-key-invalid` when it is longer than 128 characters or not printable ASCII. A replay with the same key
and the same request (method, path and body) returns the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` when
the first answer was final for it (a success, or a FINAL/OUTCOME refusal of ADR 0014); a RETRYABLE refusal
(an optimistic-lock conflict, a state or referenced fact that can change, a window in the past) is not stored,
the key is released and the retry executes again; the same key with a different request is a 409
`idempotency-key-reused`.
